name: Foundation
description: The operative reaches the ringworld's foundation. Oracle Prime reveals the final truth: the ring was built to contain something worse than the aliens. The player must choose: reset the seal, or destroy the ring entirely.

objectives.description: Survive the Oracle Shade's final protocol
Choose: reset the seal or destroy the ring

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: The foundation... it's not machinery. It's organic. The ring was grown, not built.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Prime
dialogue.line: You have come far. The seal you see before you was meant to contain the Void Speaker. It is not entirely dormant.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Shade
dialogue.line: Protocol Omega. You have earned the truth. The ring is not a prison for the aliens. It is a cage for something older.

dialogue.speaker: Oracle Echo
dialogue.line: The Void Speaker speaks in frequencies that break logic. If it escapes, it will overwrite every simulation it touches—this one included.

dialogue.speaker: Lia
dialogue.line: I'm detecting save-file corruption. That's not a metaphor. If you choose to destroy the ring, the game will end. No New Game Plus. No DLC. Just credits.
